subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR complete the compact-then-fallback contract before merge, or should maintainers accept compaction-only handling for this Anthropic 429?
rationale: Both paths change provider routing and session-state behavior for existing Anthropic setups, and the live maintainer review already requested a failoverable terminal outcome that the branch does not implement.

options.title: Complete Compact Then Fallback
options.body: Keep the classifier, but add a distinct failoverable terminal outcome only after bounded compaction/truncation exhaustion and prove the next candidate is selected safely.

options.title: Accept Classifier-Only Compaction
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that this exact Anthropic 429 no longer uses configured model fallback after exhausted compaction, with docs tightened to that policy.

options.title: Hold For Broader Fallback Policy
options.body: Keep this PR open as Anthropic-specific source work while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986 decides the generic post-overflow fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Complete Compact Then Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the classifier, but add a distinct failoverable terminal outcome only after bounded compaction/truncation exhaustion and prove the next candidate is selected safely.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and authored the live changes-requested review that defines the unresolved compact-then-fallback shape.
